name: chat-composer
title: Chat Composer
description: The box a person talks to an agent in, as a compound: an optional context strip (who it's talking to, Plan), files above an auto-growing text, and an actions row with round + and @ buttons, the model, and a round Send that morphs into Stop.

meta.whenToUse: Talking to an agent: a chat side panel, an agent's page, a full chat, a desktop quick ask. Put the model and the memory ring in ChatComposerActionsEnd and Plan in ChatComposerHeader.
meta.whenNotToUse: A comment or a reply on a record (CommentComposer), or a one-line prompt in a popover (Textarea in an InputGroup).
